fields.acceptance: A Go test seeds a state file from an earlier image of the same pid with a last poll, max runs 3, one live run and one skip, takes the lock as the new image, writes the start state and runs daemon status before any poll: it reports the new start time, the old last poll, the request's max runs, the seeded run and skip, and no stopped line
fields.statement: A daemon image writes its state before its first poll, carrying the previous image's last poll, live runs, skips and unjournaled holds, so daemon status shows a running daemon's state through a re-exec

fields.acceptance: status-terminal-current.txtar: land change set A with --change, write A into .rhiza/local/change by hand; rhiza status shows (landed) and next: rhiza change use --none; rhiza status --hook prints the hint; a model write exits with a conflict carrying the same next; after rhiza change use --none, status shows none current
fields.statement: When the current change set has landed, been withdrawn or been rejected, rhiza status and the session hook say so with next: rhiza change use --none, and a write refused for it carries the same next step
